g.text: 6 mm roundover: reconstructed from the emitted recipe G-code
Example tool: 12 mm cutting diameter, R6 quarter-circle profile, no bearing or nose extension.
The axis follows the nominal edge. The top corner rounds over; the lower edge keeps its specified position.
The tool shape controls the result.
At the original edge: 6 mm removed.
6 mm inward: original top face retained.
Below 6 mm: nominal panel edge retained.
For a cutter with a wider nose, the axis offset
is D/2 - R, rather than the rounding radius.
All four straight edges checked from actual NC.
Green: measured finished surface using the declared cutter profile. Gray: retained 19 mm board.
Computational proof only. Example geometry and feeds are not verified shop inventory or a physical cutting test.
